diagnosis.root_cause: The release-critical PRD section-3 path has never been observed at runtime because the product renders no #golden-path-probe element: the registered replay reads that element, finds nothing, and honestly concludes golden_path.state=unavailable. The signed-in flow itself is healthy and proven in-process by golden_path_section3_self_drive (src-tauri/src/lib.rs:700), and the focusboard:// machinery (PendingDeepLink argv handling, second-instance socket listener, take_deep_link IPC) is source-implemented and unit-tested, but none of it is exposed to an out-of-process observer. Loops 5-6 tuned replay and evidence lanes instead of shipping the missing product instrument, and loop 6's lane repair split at the developer filesystem boundary. Two advisory checks add debt for host-side reasons only: isolated_native_store probes a wrong bundle id and the whitebox layout checks target a foreign file layout.

stop_conditions: Stop and report if the probe is present and populated but the registered replay still cannot read it: that indicates a replay-lane defect and must not be fixed by weakening the probe contract or faking the payload.
Stop and report if observability would require broadening capabilities beyond core:event:default, rendering tokens into the UI, or running the drive outside a namespaced synthetic account.
If the replay lane cannot trigger an out-of-process activation at all, ship the golden-path gate scope and report the activation trigger as blocked or unknown instead of fabricating a receipt.
If restoring the probe breaks any frozen baseline check and cannot be repaired within the bounded scope, stop and report rather than trading baseline for instrumentation.

This plan switches the root-cause family to direct product instrumentation: the missing #golden-path-probe is implemented inside the candidate, wired to the self-drive flow the rust unit already proves, so the existing registered replay lane can conclude a real state with no host-side edits.

Six loops of replay-side and evidence-side tuning measured an absent instrument, and loop 6's host-side lane repair was unwritable. tasks.instructions: Ship the pinned product-owned gate: a hidden #golden-path-probe element wired to the existing section-3 self-drive flow (rust-unit golden_path_section3_self_drive already proves the steps in-process at src-tauri/src/lib.rs:700), so the registered focusboard-native-webdriver replay stops concluding golden_path.state=unavailable.
